from solution import check_greater


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example: check_greater([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 4) is 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'."""
    assert check_greater([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 4) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # max=5, 5-1=4 <5 so No


def test_issue_number_smaller_than_all():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' gives No when smaller than all."""
    assert check_greater([10, 20, 30], 5) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # min=10, 10-5=5 <10 so No


def test_issue_number_equal_to_max():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' gives No when equal to max."""
    assert check_greater([1, 2, 3], 3) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # max=3, 3+0=3 not >3 so No


def test_issue_number_between_elements():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' gives No when between min and max."""
    assert check_greater([1, 10], 5) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # min=1 max=10, 1+4=5 <10 so No


def test_issue_number_equal_to_min():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' gives No when equal to min only."""
    assert check_greater([2, 3, 4], 2) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # min=2 max=4, 2+0=2 <4 so No


def test_issue_single_element_equal():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' gives No when equal to sole element."""
    assert check_greater([5], 5) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # sole=5, 5+0=5 not >5 so No


def test_issue_single_element_smaller():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' gives No when smaller than sole element."""
    assert check_greater([10], 5) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # sole=10, 10-5=5 <10 so No


def test_issue_negative_between():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' gives No for negative in-between value."""
    assert check_greater([-5, -2, 0], -3) == 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # max=0, -3+3=0 not >0 so No


def test_issue_number_clearly_greater_is_not_no():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' distinguishes clearly greater value."""
    assert check_greater([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 10) != 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # max=5, 5*2=10 >5 so not No


def test_issue_number_just_above_max_is_not_no():
    """Rule 'check whether the entered number is greater than the elements' distinguishes just-above-max value."""
    assert check_greater([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 6) != 'No, entered number is less than those in the array'  # max=5, 5+1=6 >5 so not No


def test_contract_returns_string():
    """Contract: 'def check_greater(arr, number)' returns a string as in the No example."""
    result = check_greater([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 4)  # 5-1=4 input from example
    assert isinstance(result, str)  # 1+0=1 check, type must be str


def test_contract_leaves_input_unchanged():
    """Contract: 'def check_greater(arr, number)' must not mutate its array argument."""
    arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]  # 4+1=5 elements
    check_greater(arr, 4)  # 5-1=4 same as example
    assert arr == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]  # 4+1=5 elements unchanged
